Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses A) EMD in the form of RTGS/ NEFT are only acceptable. Demand Draft/ Challan or any other mode are no t acceptable. B) The successful bidder shall submit PERFORMANCE BANK GUARANTEE in accordance with the bank d etails: CORPORATE NAME: AIRPORTS AUTHORITY OF INDIA BANK NAME: ICICI BANK IFSC CODE: ICIC0000007 BG ADVISING MESSAGE: IFN 760COV (BG ISSUE) : IFN 767COV (BG AMENDMENT) UNIQUE IDENTIFIER CODE: AAIRHQWR -BG must be submitted within 30 days of contract generation. Delay in submission of BG will attract 12% p er annum interest on pro rate basis. C) SECURITY CLEARANCE: The Bidder must obtain BCAS security clearance within 30 days from the contract order issue date. Failure to meet this timeline gives the Airports Authority of India (AAI) the explicit right to cancel the contract. Core obligations, compliance rules, and operational requirements are as below; a. Critical Compliance Timeline · 30-Day Deadline: The firm must secure formal clearance for both the company entity and all individual employees through BCAS norms within 30 days of receiving the contract order (like e-Sahaj portal filin gs and police verifications to initiate the BCAS process).

· Cancellation: AAI reserves the right to terminate the contract immediately if this deadline is missed. b. Entry Passes: · Arrangement & Cost: The contractor must arrange all necessary entry passes for operational areas a nd buildings entirely at their own expense. · Issuing Authorities: Passes must be obtained from the BCAS or Security Department. · Return of Passes: All passes must be returned to the CNS-In-Charge immediately upon demand, or au tomatically upon completion of the work. c. Operational Restrictions & Penalties · Restricted Access: Personnel are strictly limited to the specific areas for which their security passe s are validated. · Immediate Expulsion: Any worker deemed "undesirable" or caught violating security regulations fra med by AAI, BCAS, or local Police Authorities will be expelled from the premises immediately. · Zero Liability: AAI will expel non-compliant workers without assigning any reason, and the contract or will have no legal claim or grounds for compensation on this account. · Staff Accountability: The bidder remains fully responsible for the conduct, compliance, and satisfact ory working of their entire staff. D) Employee State Insurance (ESI), Private Medical Insurance & Social Security: • For Employees earning BELOW ₹21,000/- (Minimum Wage): The vendor must provide statutory Employe e State Insurance (ESI). • For Employees earning ABOVE ₹21,000/-: The vendor is fully responsible for procurement and must secu re Private Social Security and Health Insurance from a private health/medical insurance provider. The insur ance value/ premium must be equal to or near to 4% of the monthly minimum wage, or comply with the la test applicable Government of India (GoI) guidelines. • Employer Contribution (AAI): 81.25% of premium or 3.25% of minimum wage whichever is lower will be r eimbursed by AAI to the vendor. • Employee Contribution: Balance premium or 0.75% of minimum wage whichever is lower must be deduc ted and contributed from the employee's salary. AAI will only process reimbursements on a monthly basis, regardless of whether the vendor pays the insur ance premium monthly or yearly. The vendor must send the ESI enrolment letter or the private policy document along with the employee's a ppointment letter. D) Bonus & National Holiday Allowance: These must be provided strictly in accordance with the prevai ling guidelines and regulations issued by the Government of India (GoI). E) Qualification: Minimum Diploma in electronics /telecom/electrical field. OR Minimum ITI in electronics /telecom/electrical trade with minimum 1-year experience in electronics /teleco m/electrical field. OR Higher Secondary (10th pass) with minimum 3 years experience in electronics /telecom/electrical field. F) Dress Code: The vendor shall ensure that all deployed manpower reports for duty in proper formal attire, consisting of a full-sleeved shirt, formal trousers, and black leather shoes. . 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 7. Purchase Preference (Centre) Purchase preference to Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs): Purchase preference will be given to MSEs as defined in Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012 dated 23.03.2012 issued by Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises and its subsequent Orders/Notifications issued by concerned Ministry. If the bidder wants to avail the Purchase preference, the bidder must be the manufacturer of the offered product in case of bid for supply of goods. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service. If L-1 is not an MSE and MSE Seller (s) has/have quoted price within L-1+ 15% of margin of purchase preference /price band defined in relevant policy, such Seller shall be given opportunity to match L-1 price and contract will be awarded for percentage of 25% of total value. 8. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 9. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 10.
